nodes.description: Public mint price per token (30 ether) stored on ShellBois and read by mintSHBSS for the payment requirement.
Maximum number of ShellBois tokens (1123); bounds the total supply check in mintSHBSS.
Maximum tokens mintable per transaction (10); caps the user-supplied _SHBSMintAmount.
Boolean pause flag checked at the very start of mintSHBSS.
IPFS base URI returned by _baseURI and used when building tokenURI.
Token URI file extension ".json" appended in tokenURI.
Counters.Counter in WithLimitedSupply tracking how many tokens have been minted.
Max supply stored in WithLimitedSupply, initialised from the constructor and returned by maxSupply().
Mapping in RandomlyAssigned used to track already-assigned token indices and resolve collisions.
Initial token ID offset (1) added to the randomly resolved value in RandomlyAssigned.nextToken.
Public payable mint: validates pause state, amount bounds, supply and payment, then loops calling nextToken() and _safeMint().
Public view override of ERC721 tokenURI; concatenates baseURI, tokenId and baseExtension.
onlyOwner payable function that forwards the entire contract balance to msg.sender via low-level send.
Internal override that derives a pseudo-random token index from block/tx values, updates tokenMatrix and returns value + startFrom.
Internal view returning the stored baseURI string.
ERC721 internal mint that calls _checkOnERC721Received, invoking onERC721Received on contract recipients (external callback).
Returns maxSupply() - tokenCount(); consumed by the ensureAvailability modifier.
Modifier requiring availableTokenCount() > 0 before any minting path executes.
Context helper returning the raw msg.sender; used as the mint recipient and as the withdraw target.
Public view in WithLimitedSupply returning the stored _maxSupply.
Caller-controlled address; used as recipient in _safeMint(_msgSender(),...) and as the withdrawal destination.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used as one of the entropy inputs in RandomlyAssigned.nextToken.
Arithmetic requirement msg.value >= cost * _SHBSMintAmount (and totalSupply() + _SHBSMintAmount <= maxSHBS) combining user input with state variables.
Low-level payable(msg.sender).send(address(this).balance) value transfer performed in withdraw().
External call to IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received triggered inside _safeMint, allowing arbitrary recipient code to execute mid-mint.
Pseudo-random index derived from msg.sender, block.coinbase, block.difficulty, block.gaslimit and block.timestamp; miner-manipulable entropy.
User-supplied mint quantity parameter of mintSHBSS.
Token ID parameter of tokenURI.
Local variable holding the nextToken() result inside the mintSHBSS loop.
Loop counter of the for-loop in mintSHBSS.
Local pseudo-random index computed modulo maxIndex in RandomlyAssigned.nextToken.
Local maxIndex = maxSupply() - tokenCount() in RandomlyAssigned.nextToken.
Local value resolved from tokenMatrix (or from random) in RandomlyAssigned.nextToken.
Counter storage-reference parameter of the Counters library functions.
Constructor parameter of WithLimitedSupply that initialises _maxSupply.
Local string holding the _baseURI() result inside tokenURI.

edges.reason: cost is multiplied by the user-supplied mint amount inside the payment requirement.
user-controlled _SHBSMintAmount is an operand of cost * _SHBSMintAmount and of the supply addition.
the arithmetic payment/supply check gates execution of the mint loop body.
the paused flag controls whether mintSHBSS continues past the first require.
maxSHBS bounds the totalSupply() + _SHBSMintAmount supply check.
maxSHBSMintAmount caps the requested mint amount.
msg.sender is used as the mint recipient through _msgSender().
_msgSender simply returns the untrusted msg.sender value.
the caller-derived recipient address flows into _safeMint.
the mintSHBSS loop invokes nextToken() to obtain each new token ID.
the nextToken() return value is stored in mintIndex.
mintIndex is forwarded as the tokenId argument of _safeMint.
block.timestamp is part of the keccak256 entropy for the pseudo-random index.
the miner-influenceable entropy determines the random index used for token assignment.
nextToken reads block.timestamp while computing the random token ID.
tokenMatrix is read to resolve collisions when assigning a token index.
nextToken writes the updated matrix entry back into tokenMatrix.
startFrom is added to the resolved value before returning the token ID.
_tokenCount provides the current count used to compute maxIndex.
maxSupply() returns the stored _maxSupply state variable.
the maxSupply() value forms maxIndex together with tokenCount().
tokenCount() is subtracted from maxSupply() to compute maxIndex.
availableTokenCount reads the current counter value.
availableTokenCount subtracts tokenCount() from maxSupply().
ensureAvailability requires availableTokenCount() > 0.
the ensureAvailability modifier gates execution of RandomlyAssigned.nextToken.
the availability requirement propagates into the minting path through nextToken().
withdraw sends the whole contract balance to the untrusted msg.sender.
withdraw performs a low-level send of the full contract balance.
the value transfer targets msg.sender, a caller-controlled address.
_safeMint calls onERC721Received on the recipient if it is a contract.
the recipient callback executes during mintSHBSS, enabling re-entrant state changes before the mint loop completes.
the tokenId parameter is encoded into the returned URI string.
_baseURI returns the stored baseURI state variable.
the _baseURI() result is stored in currentBaseURI.
currentBaseURI is concatenated into the tokenURI output.
baseExtension is appended to the tokenURI output.
the requested mint amount drives how many times the mint loop iterates.
the loop counter bounds the mint for-loop.
each loop iteration triggers an additional nextToken() call.
the Counters library parameter tracks and mutates the _tokenCount counter.
constructor parameter totalSupply_ initialises _maxSupply in WithLimitedSupply.
the resolved value is returned by nextToken as the token ID.
cost is read directly inside mintSHBSS when validating the payment.

normalization_plan.reason: user-supplied mint amount is a temporary argument whose bounds checks and payment use are entirely contained in mintSHBSS.
token ID argument exists only to build the URI string returned by tokenURI.
mintIndex is a short-lived loop local in mintSHBSS holding the nextToken() result that is immediately passed to _safeMint.
loop counter exists solely to control the mint loop iterations in mintSHBSS.
random is the direct output of the weak entropy computation and has no independent meaning outside that unsafe operation.
maxIndex is a derived intermediate of the supply arithmetic used only inside nextToken.
value is a temporary resolved index that is returned immediately by nextToken.
the Counter storage parameter only exists to let the mint path increment the shared _tokenCount counter.
constructor parameter is used only to populate _maxSupply, which is exposed by maxSupply().
currentBaseURI is a transient copy of _baseURI() used only inside tokenURI string concatenation.
